comment: Declared experiment splits. independent=false means the set has been used for development; keep it as regression only and never call it a generalization test. Verified 2026-11-28.

sets.name: semantic-train
sets.note: 245 rows from the 20-input runs and semantic routes; train per D-051.

sets.name: semantic-test
sets.note: 8 frozen scenarios. They drove fixes D-061..D-074 and later rounds, so treat as regression, not generalization.

sets.name: narration-corpus
sets.note: 424 rows but only 241 unique prompts; 183 alternate/version targets, 2 duplicated ids. Any prompt-level split must dedupe first.

sets.name: narration-holdout58
sets.note: E38 32-group hash holdout, used by E43/E45/E46. Exclusion from training rows is manual, not gate-enforced.

sets.name: narration-bundle161
sets.note: The 161 points used to design E55-E60 rules; not an independent evaluation set.

sets.name: narration-holdout-v1
sets.note: 87 pairs from artifacts/goal/narration runs; fact-block hash absent from the 225 corpus and 97 bundle hashes. Built by build_narration_holdout.py.

sets.name: semantic-probes-dev
sets.note: Authored from world initialAppearance; entities whose names appear in the semantic train text are excluded.

sets.name: semantic-probes-test
sets.note: Same construction as dev; keep it for formal scoring only.

sets.name: narration-holdout-v2-newrun
sets.note: One turn from the 2026-11-28 new-input run (1/4 completed); fact block absent from corpus/bundle, outcome labels present. Smoke only.

pairs.note: holdout is carved from the planning pool by design
50 of the 58 holdout ids reappear in the corpus as alternate/version targets; corpus is a reference pool, not the E46 training set. Training on the corpus must exclude holdout prompts.
